coverage: All original files, including failed cases, logs and native histories; none omitted or rewritten

archive.metadata_normalization: gzip mtime 0; tar mtime/uid/gid 0, empty owner names, mode 0644; original file contents unchanged

examples.purpose: Transient fault with lost response; committed effect reconciled
Tampered and stale approval rejected; no effect; cancelled

scope_limit: Native run executed the frozen commit. Later assurance-tool/documentation changes do not retroactively change these results or prove a fresh integration run.
